sounds.title: Forest
variants: Peaceful forest at night for falling asleep: a soft breeze through leaves, gentle distant crickets, an occasional quiet owl far away, steady and calm, no sudden or loud sounds
Calm forest in the early morning: soft wind in tall trees, light rustling leaves, sparse gentle birdsong in the distance, steady relaxing ambience, no sudden sounds

sounds.title: Calm waterfall
variants: Slow, gentle waterfall heard from a distance: soft unhurried water falling over smooth stones, a low steady murmur, calm and spacious, no rushing or splashing, for sleep
A small, slow trickle of water falling softly into a quiet forest pool: gentle unhurried drops and a soft low flow, peaceful and spacious, for sleep

sounds.title: Sea waves
variants: Slow, gentle sea waves rolling onto a sandy beach at night: soft foam, long calm pauses between waves, peaceful and steady, no wind or seagulls, for sleep
Calm ocean waves softly washing in and out on a pebble shore: a slow, regular rhythm, distant and soothing, no wind or seagulls, for sleep

sounds.title: Water filling a pot
variants: Water dripping slowly into a metal pot, single drops falling one by one every second or two, soft resonant plinks, quiet room, calm and steady
Slow drops of water falling into a pot that is filling up: gentle deep plops one at a time, a quiet steady rhythm, peaceful and relaxing

sounds.title: Calm Chinese drums
sounds.note: Played as two layers half a loop apart (lib/sleep-sounds.ts), so its beats come twice as often. Asking the model for faster beats ignored the timing.
variants: Slow, calm Chinese temple drum played softly with padded mallets: deep warm low booms with long gaps between them, meditative and peaceful, gentle reverb, quiet

sounds.title: Flute
variants: A lonely pan flute playing a slow, haunting melody with long sustained notes and gentle vibrato, wide cinematic reverb in the style of a classic western film score, calm and soothing
Soft breathy pan flute with long sustained notes over a quiet low string drone, melancholic and peaceful, spacious cinematic reverb, slow and dreamy, for sleep
